annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear condition under which a user agent should not send a Content-Length header field. It specifies that this applies when the request message does not contain payload data and the method semantics do not anticipate such data. The language is prescriptive (SHOULD NOT) and does not allow for multiple materially different interpretations. There is no missing constraint that would affect implementation behavior.
